title: MO-GRPO: Mitigating Reward Hacking of Group Relative Policy Optimization on Multi-Objective Problems

rs.key_step: 逐objective先组内标准化再求和，不先加reward再统一std。
rs.why_non_obvious: 消除尺度主导但等权不等于正确价值权衡；相关reward仍影响最终相关系数。
rs.trigger_condition: When reward channels have unequal scales, standardize each channel before aggregation.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When reward channels have unequal scales, standardize each channel before aggregation.

signatures.failure_boundary: 等权可不符合真实偏好；无限组理论不保证有限样本或代理可信。

relevance.how: 独立标准化会消除各通道共同正scale，需显式后置权重。
多reward尺度控制不能消除caption proxy本身偏差。
